A '''Wrist-hawk''' was a type of [[Bird/Legends|bird]].<ref name="DS" />

[[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Villian Dance]] once compared [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] as [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] wrist-hawk.<ref name="DS" />
